sloka: जनौघै स्तैर्विसर्पद्भिः शुश्रुवे तत्र निस्वनः ।पर्वसूदीर्णवेगस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः ॥२-६-२७॥
transliteration: janaughai stairvisarpadbhiḥ śuśruve tatra nisvanaḥ ।parvasūdīrṇavegasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ ॥2-6-27॥

translations.english: The multitudes of men moving to and fro gave rise to a noise like the roar of the ocean enhanced by the violent speed (of the wind) on the full and new moon days.
